archetype: Archetype 2 (The Performance Pro) modified for Tactical Luxury
reasoning: The tactical flashlight domain demands a robust, high-performance aesthetic (Deep Obsidian). The user requested a dark anthracite theme with specific gold accents (#FFBD11). We ensure high readability for senior users and a clean, simplified interface.

rules: Use Outfit for all headings to provide a geometric, modern, and non-generic look (respecting E1 constraints against Inter for headings).
Use Inter for body text to maximize readability, especially for senior users as requested.
Base font size must be slightly larger (16px-18px) to accommodate senior users.
Never center-align dense data or form labels. Keep them left-aligned for scanning.
Use generous padding inside cards (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision and maintain the 'interface épurée' request.
Gap strategy: tight (gap-4 to gap-6) for dashboards.
Containers must use 1px subtle borders (border-border) with no heavy drop-shadows. Shadows should be ambient (shadow-lg with low opacity).
Buttons must be rounded-full or rounded-xl to respect the 'Boutons arrondis' requirement.
Cards should have rounded-2xl or rounded-xl.

global: Use Shadcn UI for tables, calendars, forms, dialogs, and tabs. Strip default Vercel-look by applying the anthracite/gold palette.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) MUST have a data-testid attribute for testing (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Use Phosphor Icons (or Lucide) for clear, modern iconography.
buttons: Primary Button: bg-primary text-black font-semibold rounded-full hover:bg-primary/90 transition-colors px-6 py-3
Secondary Button: bg-secondary text-white font-medium rounded-full hover:bg-secondary/80 transition-colors px-6 py-3
cards: Use flat solid surfaces (bg-card) with subtle 1px borders. Do NOT use glassmorphism for the dashboard data cards to maintain high contrast and readability.
data_tables: Rows must have adequate height (py-4) for senior readability.
Status badges should be pill-shaped (rounded-full) using subtle background tints (e.g., bg-green-500/10 text-green-500 for 'Livrée').

login.visuals: Use the generated login background image on one half of the screen, and the login form on the other half (dark anthracite background).

features: Dashboard Overview: Daily/Weekly/Monthly Revenue, Pending Orders, Critical Stock Alerts, Latest Orders.
Order Management: List with filters (Pending, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled), Order Details, Manual Order Entry.
Stock Management: Product list with quantities, customizable alert thresholds, stock movement history.
Customer Management: Client files, purchase history, contact info.
Accounting: Expense entry, automated sales tracking, manual bank reconciliation, Excel export button.
WooCommerce Sync: Configuration fields for Consumer Key, Consumer Secret, and Store URL.
ONLY displays orders that need shipping.
Data shown per order: Client Name, Delivery Address, Products Ordered, Quantities.
Action: A single, massive button 'Marquer comme expédié' (Mark as shipped).
Stats: Revenue evolution charts, Top-selling products.
AI Space: Text area to describe a post, 'Générer' button, and a display area for the AI-generated content.
